main_text.l: Genitiuo. Dela vel della, der, huius.
Datiuo. alla vel a la, der, huic.
Ablatiuo. dalla vel dala, von der, abhac.
Genitiuo. delle, vel dele, deren, harum.
Datiuo. alle vel ale, denen, his.
Ablatiuo. dalle. oder da le, von den.
Nelli, negli, nei ne, in denen.
Per lo, pel, pello, durch den,
Per li, pergli, pelli, per i, pei, pe, durch die.
Per la, durch die, durch sie.

page.notes: Side labels and brace groupings in the margins are described, not transcribed in full. The marginal Gothic-style words and the paradigm lines are approximate in places due to scan quality; the word "Ne" and "Per" are brace labels. Some text near the paradigm is faint.
